Tarikh | Episode 1046 | 21 August 2025
# In 185 BCE, Pushyamitra Shunga, a general, assassinated the last Mauryan king, ending their rule.
# He founded the Shunga dynasty in Magadha. His reign saw the revival of Vedic traditions, evidenced by two Ashwamedha Yajnas.
# He also successfully repelled Yavana (Indo-Greek) invasions from the northwest.
# The period is noted for significant literary and artistic works, including the Bharhut Stupa and the Besnagar Garuda Pillar.
